name: navigation
description:
## Shared Portfolio Navigation
Reusable app-owned horizontal navigation using core `bln-navigation`, including its native responsive/collapsed menu and keyboard behavior.

### Destinations
Sibling page names and URLs are `home` → `/home`, `about` → `/about`, `projects` → `/projects`, and `contact` → `/contact`. All four items use schema-confirmed `LinkState` objects with those page names, not root-relative URLs or invented app-prefixed states. The clickable Portfolio brand links to `home`. Navigation MenuItem `openIn` values are `current-window` and `new-window`; every item explicitly uses `current-window`. The brand exposes only `link`, not an `openIn` binding, and retains the core component's same-window brand navigation.

### Appearance and accessibility
Inherits the active Portfolio theme's supported navigation settings: white surface against the app's ivory background, ink brand/text, teal hover/active accents, padded menu items, rounded interaction surfaces, and subtle bottom border. Existing app theme remains unchanged. Verified Font Awesome 5 solid briefcase/envelope icons supplement the visible Projects/Contact labels; no icon-only controls, imagery, utility classes, custom CSS, or logo URL. Native collapse state and toggle behavior are not overridden.

children.comments: Retains the core responsive navigation and built-in toggle with no forced collapsed state. Brand uses the supported link binding (same-window core behavior); menu items use the verified hyphenated current-window value, not bln-link's different underscore convention. Sibling page names are used directly as states. Appearance is supplied entirely by the existing Portfolio navigation theme settings. Visible text accompanies both verified icons.
